805163104001591-SurvivalTutorial-.name: I lost those items you gave me...

805155104001588-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Life as a mushroom isn't easy, you know…

805154204001580-SurvivalTutorial-.name: There's a training area on the northwest side of $map:02000499$ where you can toss bombs around. Mushrooms can do it, and so can you.

803231604001576-SurvivalTutorial-.name: You lost them? Well, that's all I had. So uhh, good luck.

803231604001578-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Hehe! That looked fun. Wasn't that $npcName:29000403[gender:1]$ easy to defeat? If not, you're going to have a bad time in Mushtopia. Well, off you go then! Have fun!

805171904001592-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Heheh! Welcome to $map:02000499$! There's a special gift for you in the chest behind me!

805171904001597-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Huh? The chest was empty? Try asking a nearby staff member!

806052304001598-SurvivalTutorial-.name: My shift's almost over, so I'm thinking of heading over to the training area to toss some bombs around.

806052304001600-SurvivalTutorial-.name: You mean it sounds like fun! Toss 'em up and watch them go boom. Give it a try. I think you get some kind of prize the first time you do it. Just uh, maybe aim away from the tourists. We don't want another incident.

806052304001601-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Just three hours, twenty-nine minutes and thirty-seven seconds until my shift ends…

806052304001602-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Huh? A mysterious force told you you'd get a gift if you talked to me? That's weird. Well, wouldn't want to disappoint the universe. Um, here, take these.

830123414003822--.name: Good to see you, $MyPCName$! You caught my attention today because your outfit is quite spectacular! Say, $MyPCName$, do you know the myth of Olympus?

830123414003823--.name: It's about the constellation Taurus, you see. Zeus was captivated by Europa and transformed into a bull to woo her.

830123414003824--.name: That bull later become the constellation Taurus! Neat, right? Wondering why it's relevant to you? I'll tell you... once you've equipped the full Olympus set!

830123414003825--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Olympus outfit! Hehe!

830123414003826--.name: Oh, my! You look like you've popped straight out of some myth! You'll look perfect riding around on this $item:50600194$!

831180815000001--.name: Good to see you, $MyPCName$! You caught my attention today because your outfit is quite spectacular! Say, $MyPCName$, do you like cats?

831180815000002--.name: Silly me, of course you do! Otherwise, you wouldn't be wearing what you're wearing, would you? You know, I love cats, too! But you take it to a whole other level... Cat and neon? By still my heart!

831180815000003--.name: How awesome would you look in the entire Technokitty set, am I right? I really want to see that! Show me, and I'll even give you a present that will match beautifully!

831180815000004--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Technokitty outfit! Hehe!

831180815000005--.name: Look at that fun! Look at that funky! You, my friend, are a funkster, and you definitely deserve this $item:20301955$! Way to go, $MyPCName$!

1106141115000045--.name: Well, isn't that a special outfit? It seems you want to be cute like a kitten.

1106141115000046--.name: I've got the perfect Kitten Maid outfit for you, $MyPCName$. I can't wait to see the cuteness ooze from your every pore when you put it on!

1106141115000047--.name: If you equip the entire Kitten Maid set and show it to me, I will give you a $item:20302118$ in return.

1106141115000048--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Kitten Maid set! Hehe!

1106141115000049--.name: Cuteness upon cuteness! I wasn't prepared for how adorable you look. Take your kitty cuteness to the next level with this  $item:20302118$.

1119135915000050--.name: Is there an image that comes to mind when you hear the word angel? Did you think of a beautiful angel with pure white wings? In that case, I want to tell you all about fallen angels.

1119135915000051--.name: Some people think of devils when the hear about fallen angels. There are many stories of devils that were banished and became fallen angels. Even so, fallen angels are pretty popular!

1119135915000052--.name: Maybe that's why they appeared before us in such a beautiful form! Just like the clothes you're wearing right now, $MyPCName$! I'll give you a special badge as a gift if you equip the entire Fallen Angel set!

1119135915000053--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Fallen Angel set! Hehe!

1119135915000054--.name: Wow! It's grim, but noble! I've seen you many times, but this is the most beautiful you've ever looked!

1127124615000055--.name: The cold winter is already upon us. But winter's got its good points, too! For example, I get to see the brightly shining clothes that you're wearing!

1127124615000056--.name: I imagine a snow spirit making snow fall on everyone to give them joy. Doesn't that sound like a fairytale?

1127124615000057--.name: But what you're wearing is making me imagine such things! I wonder how beautiful it would be if you equip the entire set? I look forward to it! If you look like a snow spirit from a fairytale, I'll give you a weapon skin to match the look!

1127124615000058--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Snow Tale set! Hehe!

1127124615000059--.name: Wow! You really look like you will make the snow fall! It's very beautiful!

1214152515000060--.name: $MyPCName$, do you like shiny things? I ask because your new outfit positively shimmers!

1214152515000061--.name: I'm so jealous of your shiny clothes.

1214152515000062--.name: I love shiny things too. I can't imagine how beautifully you'll shine wearing the entire set! I'd love to see it. In fact, if you come back wearing the full set, I'll give you a special gift!

1214152515000063--.name: I think you're still missing a few items from the Luminaire outfit! Hehe!

1214152515000064--.name: Wow! You are shining brightly! It's dazzingly beautiful!

1227162015000065--.name: Sometimes looking up at the night sky makes me think of distant, otherworldly places. Looking at you, $MyPCName$, makes me think of those people living in the heavens!

1227162015000066--.name: Everyone heard stories of such people at least once in their lifetime! Light and fluttering! They are very graceful!

1227162015000067--.name: $MyPCName$, even you look like you will fly up to the sky soon! Look like one of those heavenly people and I will give you a nice fan that you can fly on!

1227162015000068--.name: You still need an item or two or five to complete the Heavenly Being set! Hehe!

1227162015000069--.name: Show me how great you look as you fly to the sky!

304143915000070--.name:
$MyPCName$さんはまるでマジシャンのような装いですね。
そんな$MyPCName$さんにどうしても話したいことがあって、お呼びしました！

304143915000071--.name:
出る！消える！変わる！
$MyPCName$さんが素敵なマジシャンになったら、
メイプルワールドの人気スターになること間違いなしです！

304143915000072--.name:
$MyPCName$さんがマジシャンデビューしたら
コディアが絶対見にいきますので、マジシャンのアシスタントになるチャンスをください！

304143915000073--.name: イリュージョニストアバターセットを完成するには、まだ少～し足りないようです！

304143915000074--.name:
マジシャンになる$MyPCName$さんにとって時間は
とても大切なものだなぁと思って用意したものです！

912180315000030--.name: Hi, $MyPCName$! I rushed over here to tell you about some special quests hidden inside outfits you might encounter soon!

912180315000031--.name: You'll know you've encountered one when you see a quest mark displayed on the outfit's icon! Equip the item, and you'll be given a special quest!

912180315000032--.name: Hover your mouse over items with hidden quests to view a detailed description. Equip the item, and I'll visit you with a special quest!

912180315000034--.name: It's a secret which outfits have hidden quests, hehe! Here's a little gift, $MyPCName$, to wish you good luck in getting a surprise quest soon!

217013702004908--.name: The deep corruption of the $map:02000350$'s is sure to wear on you the deeper you travel inside. I've prepared some gifts for weary warriors returning from their battle against the darkness.

217013702004909--.name: $MyPCName$, when combatting the corruption of the $map:02000350$ begisn to wear on you, come see me. It won't be much, but hopefully I'll have a gift that can help you.

217013702004910--.name: $MyPCName$, when combatting the corruption of the $map:02000350$ begisn to wear on you, come see me. It won't be much, but hopefully I'll have a gift that can help you.

217013702004911--.name: Oh... $MyPCName$! How far did you get? I can feel that the corruption remains, but at least you are unharmed. I'd like you to have this $item:30000524$ for your efforts.

217013702004912--.name: If you gather enough, you can use them to open the special treasure chests I sell in my shop. I'm certain what's inside will be of use to you.

102145212002983-Timaion01-.name:
幸好我已经通过$npcName:11003597[gender:0]$确定了$item:30000975$的位置。
位置就在$map:02020004$的$map:52020009$。

102145212002984-Timaion01-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$item:30000975$</font>应该就在那里面。
你把它给我带回来吧。

102145212002988-Timaion01-.name:
没什么。
祝你平安归来。呵呵呵……。

102145212002990-Timaion01-.name: 能不能给我说说房屋的名字为什么叫$map:52020009$？

102145212002991-Timaion01-.name:
你在房子里走两圈就知道了。
公主可没工夫和你闲聊。
快去快回吧。

102145212002994-Timaion01-.name: <font color="#909090">（这家伙触碰了含有黑暗力量的碎片却平安无事，有意思。）</font>

102145212002995-Timaion01-.name: 哎，你寻找碎片的过程中，有没有发现什么异常？

102145212002996-Timaion01-.name:
我看见被碎片的力量吸引的怪物纷纷聚集在碎片附近。
估计其他碎片所在地点的情形也差不多。

102145212002997-Timaion01-.name:
被碎片的力量吸引来的怪物。……
也许这可以作为我们寻找碎片所在处的提示。

102150812002998-Timaion01-.name:
正巧我知道个怪物异常聚集的地方——
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020007$</font>。

102150812003000-Timaion01-.name:
嗯，$map:02020007$。
照你所说的话，在那里应该可以追踪到碎片的痕迹。

102150812003002-Timaion01-.name: <font color="#909090">（是我的错觉吗？公主的语气视乎有些机械化。）</font>

102150812003003-Timaion01-.name:
你还琢磨什么，快去快回吧。
我们有义务必须比其他人更快找到碎片。

102150812003006-Timaion01-.name: <font color="#909090">（越想越觉得有意思。要不再观察一阵子？）</font>

102171112003015-Timaion01-.name:
想打听什么，尽管问！
我都告诉你！

102171112003016-Timaion01-.name: 打听含有异常力量的碎片。

102171112003017-Timaion01-.name: 问它为什么被打坏丢弃了。

102171112003018-Timaion01-.name:
你是被那力量吸引过来的？
我原先也是奉主人的命令，来这里寻找那股力量！

102171112003020-Timaion01-.name:
主人说，碎片就在这个地方的某处。
碎片会释放出非常巨大的力量。
使我的朋友们发生了变异……。

102171112003021-Timaion01-.name:
碎片所在地点就在$map:02020007$里的<font color="#ffd200">$map:52020010$</font>。
啊！既然你救了我，我就领你去有那股力量的地方吧。
虽然有点害怕……。

102171112003023-Timaion01-.name:
是我的朋友把我弄成这样的。
他们受碎片的力量影响，变得很狂暴，袭击了我。

102171112003024-Timaion01-.name:
袭击我的朋友是我最好的挚友之一。
想当年我们第一次见面……。

102171112003025-Timaion01-.name: （打开了话匣子的$npcName:11003603[gender:0]$的故事一时半会儿都没有要结束的样子。）

102171112003026-Timaion01-.name:
于是，我就这么被打坏，丢弃在森林里了。
你要是想听更多故事，随时问我。

102171112003027-Timaion01-.name: <font color="#909090">（估计不受碎片力量的影响，它也会被打坏。）</font>

102171112003028-Timaion01-.name: 还是收起我的好奇心吧。

102171112003029-Timaion01-.name:
那我们出发！
进入我生成的传送门吧！

102171112003030-Timaion01-.name:
你怎么又回来了？
你不是要去碎片所在地吗？

102171112003034-Timaion01-.name: 需要我把刚才的故事再讲一遍吗？

102171112003036-Timaion01-.name:
唉……。
<font color="#909090">（在$npcName:11003603[gender:0]$带路期间，我不得不一直听它没完没了地讲故事。）</font>

102171112003037-Timaion01-.name:
喀喀喀…… 
谢谢你，我好久没这样尽情说话啦。

102171112003038-Timaion01-.name:
到了！
这就是你要找的力量所在地。
这里真的好恐怖……。

102171112003040-Timaion01-.name: 不！只是因为这座房屋的时间被扭曲了，所以你看不到！

102171112003041-Timaion01-.name:
人类……，
你一脸白痴的表情。

102171112003042-Timaion01-.name:
你亲自体验一下就知道了。
你去摆弄一下大厅里的<font color="#ffd200">时钟</font>。

102171112003043-Timaion01-.name:
你去摆弄一下大厅里的<font color="#ffd200">时钟</font>。
你莫非不相信我的话？

102171112003044-Timaion01-.name:
看见了吧？
这就表明屋里的时间被扭曲了。

102171112003045-Timaion01-.name: 如果不把屋里的时间恢复原样，你就没法找到碎片。

102171112003046-Timaion01-.name:
话说回来，我没看见那些变异的朋友，有点担心。
不知道它们是不是出事了。

102172312003047-Timaion01-.name:
不知为什么，屋里的时间恢复正常了！
是你干的？

102172412003047-Timaion01-.name:
喀喀……抓紧时间，人类！
我怕我会受<font color="#ffd200">碎片</font>的力量影响，发狂攻击你。

102172412003050-Timaion01-.name:
咳呃……咳呃……。
力量……要撑不住了……你快走……。

102172412003052-Timaion01-.name:
你去$map:02020007$的期间，我派$npcName:11003600[gender:0]$去调查了其他碎片的位置。
正如预料，在$map:02020004$和$map:02020005$各有一块碎片。
